definitions.gloss: to approach; to come near; to draw close
definitions.explanation: To move physically closer to someone or something. Can also be used figuratively for approaching a topic or person emotionally. An intransitive godan verb with the ～に particle marking the target.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧{近寄|ちかよ}ってきた。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近寄|ちかよ}らない⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You'd better not go near that building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見知|みし}らぬ{人|ひと}→見知らぬ人：26016_mishiranuhito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{近寄|ちかよ}ってきた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{警戒|けいかい}した→警戒する：25375_keikaisuru⟧。
examples.english: A stranger approached me, so I became a little wary.

notes:
USAGE:
The target of approach is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{近寄|ちかよ}る. Often appears with ～てくる to indicate approaching the speaker, or ～ていく for moving away from the speaker toward something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{近寄|ちかよ}る (to approach ~)
- {近寄|ちかよ}ってくる (to come closer — toward speaker)
- {近寄|ちかよ}らないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please don't come near)
- {近寄|ちかよ}りがたい (unapproachable, intimidating)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧ is very similar and often interchangeable, but {近寄|ちかよ}る tends to emphasize deliberate physical movement toward a target, while ⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧ can also describe things becoming closer in time or abstract distance.
